text: THE DBIM IMPORTANT LINKS NO LONGER LIST THE DIVISIONS. The page carried a row for each of the Department's ten divisions after its priority destinations, which is not how dosje.gov.in organises its Important Links. They are taken out; the list is now the four home-page actions (Nasha Mukt Bharat e-Pledge, Become a Nasha Mukti Mitr, Find a De-addiction Centre, SAMAVESH Services Gateway) and the five priority destinations (Dashboard, Tenders, Public Grievance Redressal Mechanism, Social Audit MIS Portal, What's New) — nine rows on one page. The home section's four rows are unchanged, and the divisions remain under Ministry › Our Division.
